szoveg_eredeti:
Ann Davis Vaughan / The Information :

 Public records appear to show SpaceX building a “Starbase supercomputer” in TX, but Gina Hinojosa's election as governor may delay some of the data center plans   —  Elon Musk moved early to build AI data centers in Tennessee and Mississippi and reaped the rewards.
